rules.REQUIRED_promoter: Polos Social Lounge, #150 – 950 Emerald Drive, Sherwood Park, AB T8H 0W6.
rules.REQUIRED_eligibility: Open to residents of Alberta who are 19 years of age or older. Employees of Polos Social Lounge and members of their households are not eligible.
rules.REQUIRED_drawDates: One winner is drawn at random from all eligible entries within the first week after each quarter ends (January, April, July and October).
rules.REQUIRED_entryDeadlines: Entries for each draw close at 11:59 PM Mountain Time on the last day of the quarter (March 31, June 30, September 30 and December 31).
rules.REQUIRED_winnerNotification: The winner is contacted by email and has 14 days to respond. If there is no response, another winner is drawn.
rules.REQUIRED_skillTestingQuestion: Winner must correctly answer a mathematical skill-testing question.
rules.oddsStatement: Odds of winning depend on the number of eligible entries received for that draw.
rules.prizeConditions: One $200 Polos gift card per draw. The prize must be accepted as awarded and cannot be exchanged for cash.
rules.privacy: By signing up, you agree that Polos Social Lounge may use your email address to send news, advertising and promotional offers. You can unsubscribe at any time.
